title: Hepatobiliary cancers digital twins: Integrating artificial intelligence-driven multi-omics with organoid dynamics.
snippet: Static biomarkers are increasingly failing to predict outcomes in hepatobiliary cancers, largely due to the profound heterogeneity of the tumor microenvironment. Over the past decade, rapid advances in digital pathology, single-cell profiling, and spatial multi-omics have generated increasingly detailed maps of tumor architecture.
